info.title: AgentShip platform, worker and local bridge API
info.description: Draft.13 adds live chat lease context, collaboration actions, attempt history and scoped artifact archives. Draft.12 adds check history, repair control targets and lease-bound repair actions. Draft.11 adds explicit Agent dispatch opt-in, check candidate and node execution projections. Draft.10 adds Git preparation step evidence, scoped external dispatch/reconcile decisions and worker checkpoint evidence. Proposed API v1 for BRD v0.57 and PRD v0.8 on the React and Java design baseline. Draft.9 adds pending gitPlan and pinned selectedRoles to run projections. Draft.8 adds workflowVersion to flow configuration projections so sealed graph versions remain distinct from optimistic configuration versions. Draft.7 account and owner/deputy access rules and draft.4 worker and run contracts carry forward. The historical Node.js prototype uses a different interface. Readiness and open policy items are tracked in the System Design Index.

servers.description: Same-origin platform. Local verification binds to loopback only.

get.description: Read current browser identity or a null user.
Read the email and phone of the authenticated session account. No target-account selector. Do not reuse this schema for login, session, member, or chat projections. Responses must not be cached.

post.description: Validate matching passwords and the case-insensitive username key. Both email and phone must be verified. Acceptance acknowledges registration and the required channels without issuing a browser session. An account remains pending until both channels are verified. Email uniqueness ignores case and phones are normalized with a country code before uniqueness checking. Registration passwords are 15 to 128 characters, allow spaces and symbols, and must match exactly. Development uses local simulated email and phone delivery. Pending registrations expire 24 hours after acceptance. Expired identifiers can be registered again. Do not expose codes or provider secrets in responses.

202.description: Registration accepted for verification without a business session.

post.description: Verify one channel using proof scoped to this registration and channel. Check proof and registration expiration. Both successful channels atomically activate the account. Verification never issues a business session. Wrong, expired, or mismatched proof receives a generic rejection. Rate-limit by registration and origin.

200.description: Accepted channel proof. A repeat of valid proof for the same channel leaves the existing verification unchanged.

post.description: Authenticate by normalized username or email and password. On success, issue the browser session cookie. Pending accounts are ineligible until both contacts are verified. Wrong credentials and ineligible accounts receive the same generic authentication response.
Invalidate session and its chat leases, then clear the browser cookie.

get.description: List projects visible to the caller.

List configured Agent candidates for the flow editor. A role template without an owned configuration is not an executable candidate. An existing flowId requires current edit permission. Without flowId, require permission to create a flow. Require current primary or unrevoked deputy ownership of each Agent configuration. Standalone grants are outside the first-development profile. Search and pagination apply after authorization; saving a flow revalidates every referenced Agent under current permissions. Return an opaque next cursor scoped to caller and filters. Order by normalized display name then immutable Agent ID.

Return results under current permissions and the declared intent. Requirement purpose=view includes visible deputy entries with allowedActions lacking start. Requirement purpose=start lists only requirements the caller can start. For flows purpose=use, require requirementId and start permission on that requirement, then return only saved flows for which the caller is the current owner or an unrevoked deputy. The same flow list serves all work types. For agents purpose=use, use the context-aware catalog endpoint. The start and save commands recheck authorization and version; a list entry is not a durable grant.

post.description: Create a configuration. The creator becomes its owner. Flow creation validates all selected Agents under current use permissions. In the development profile, formal publication nodes are unavailable.

get.description: Read a configuration with current permissions.

patch.description: Recheck current edit permissions and expected version. A flow edit also checks current use permission for every selected Agent. In the development profile, formal publication nodes are unavailable. An edit by a removed deputy returns ACCESS_REVOKED only when prior edit authority on this object can be established.

post.description: Only the current owner can change deputies or transfer. Unknown or ineligible username returns 404 MEMBER_UNAVAILABLE. Add and transfer resolve one exact normalized username after object and actor authorization. An ineligible or unknown username produces the same MEMBER_UNAVAILABLE response. Remove uses the ID of an existing deputy from the authorized member projection. Mutation checks the expected version. An authenticated original actor may replay a successful transfer with the same operation, object, key and canonical digest after losing ownership and receive only the prior minimal receipt. A changed digest, different actor or expired receipt never replays a transfer. A fresh read or write uses current authorization.

200.description: Minimal ownership receipt, including permitted identical replays.

get.description: List the caller's registered devices and their last observed status.

post.description: Issue a short-lived, one-time pairing code. If delivery is uncertain, request a fresh code. Secrets are not persisted in command receipts.
Issue a short-lived start challenge bound to the browser session and platform origin. Rate limit issuance and validate each challenge exactly once.

get.description: List authorized runs, including device presence and the run's own status.

post.description: Recheck requirement start and workflow use permissions under current grants and the submitted versions, then consume device proof, snapshot the selected flow and roles, and queue Git preparation. A flow with formal publication is unavailable in the development profile. An unlinked requirement requires feature work type and a GitHub account or organization in githubNamespace; the new repository is public. A linked requirement uses its existing repository, and githubNamespace must be omitted.

get.description: Read an authorized run snapshot and server-evaluated action permissions. Display names come from immutable selected Agent versions. Nodes expose their pinned input revision once started and whether that input is older than the current run revision. Use the attempt history resource for previous attempts.

Read a coalesced notification for the current run version. A changed version returns a hint to fetch run details. This endpoint does not replay each intermediate transition or return private chat content.

Read paged task attempts, including prior attempts, for a currently authorized run. Role labels use the frozen Agent version. Sort by task ID and attempt number in ascending order. Cursors bind caller, run and filters, and use exclusive keyset continuation. Refresh from the first page for a new scan; a page does not freeze attempt state. No chat bodies, provider secrets or raw logs are returned.
Resolve a scoped artifact and a permitted content reference.

Return paged chat content and current node and wave targets to the entitled page holding the active lease. A chat-only guest can use this endpoint without run-board access. Recheck permission and lease on every read, including continuation. Cursor order is immutable platform acceptance order; ordinary text is not copied into run notifications or artifacts.

post.description: Acquire, renew or release the exclusive page lease for the run initiator or a current entitled guest. This entry point does not require run-board, project or requirement read permission. A current requirement deputy cannot acquire, renew or operate the lease. Logout or permission revocation invalidates access immediately. Only authorized contenders see an occupied result. For a page-close release only, CSRF token may be supplied in the body.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Browser session anti-CSRF token, also sent on page-close keepalive release.

get.description: Read current granted chat users for the run initiator. Only minimal identity projection is returned. No lease is required.

post.description: Only the authenticated run initiator may grant or revoke chat access for this run. These commands do not require a chat lease. Grant resolves an exact username under current authorization; unknown and ineligible names return 404 MEMBER_UNAVAILABLE. A current requirement deputy is ineligible even if a prior grant exists. Revoke invalidates the guest lease and authorization atomically and applies to open pages and new reads or writes immediately. Grant and revoke do not create project, requirement, or run-board permissions.

Recheck authorization specific to the action, active page lease and action state. Entitled chat-only guests can send messages and answer open questions without run-board access. Other commands enforce their own actor conditions. Message uses an explicit current node and wave; omitting targetRoleId selects its coordinator, while an explicit target resolves only within that wave. Unavailable or invalid targets return 409 CHAT_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE without fallback. Reply and cancel use the original question, and only the initiator can cancel. BRD change proposal and confirmation require the active BRD node and both expected revisions. Only the run initiator confirms; confirmation atomically updates the source requirement and run revision. Started waves retain pinned inputs. Skip is a recorded disposition for a failed selected Agent and does not waive the final artifact condition. External recovery needs an approved grant. Formal publication approval is reserved and returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED in the development release. Downstream rules for node rerun are outside current implementation scope.
Exchange a valid single-use pairing code for device credentials.
Renew valid active task leases, claim new tasks for this device, and receive inbox deliveries.

Report a typed event for the current device, task, attempt and lease epoch. After deduplication and fencing, accept only the next contiguous sequence in this epoch; a gap returns 409 EVENT_SEQUENCE_GAP. A previously accepted identical event returns its original receipt. A message is nonterminal and verifies the session bound to the current attempt. If inReplyToInboxId is supplied, verify its task and session before storing the message. Platform derives sender and recipient, writes the event and chat projection atomically, and publishes only a content-free run notification.

get.description: Loopback companion status for the exact paired Origin. Never returns device credentials or signing keys.

post.description: Loopback-only proof. Restrict Origin to paired platform. Sign this challenge without exposing device credentials.

Record an external operation intent and recheck current lease, destination, authorization and the affected route pause under the run lock before a mutating external effect. A paused route cannot receive a new write authorization. Other eligible routes continue. A prior operation may be reconciled without a new write. Formal publication dispatch is reserved and returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED in the development profile. The body and path task IDs must agree.

200.description: Short-lived authorization scoped to the requested external effect.

get.description: Read check targets in the current active route. Requires chat access. Actions separately require the current session and tab lease.

post.description: Approve one exact final artifact snapshot for a create-only tag in the bound requirement repository. Only the initiator who remains the current requirement owner may approve.
Claim archive work on its original device. A pinned export commit is read-only reconciliation.
Persist an exact export commit before issuing one short write authorization. Further requests only reconcile.
Verify current lease and exact tag/readback commit, or preserve a known failure or unknown result.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Opaque command key. Scope is caller and operation. Reuse only for an identical request.

ChatLease.name: X-Chat-Lease
ChatLease.description: Opaque credential for this page's current lease. Never persist or log.

HistoryTaskFilter.name: taskId
HistoryTaskFilter.description: Restrict history to the given task in the run.

HistoryNodeFilter.name: nodeId
HistoryNodeFilter.description: Restrict history to all recorded waves of the given node in the run.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor scoped to the caller and filters.

PageSize.name: pageSize
PageSize.description: Requested number of results, capped by platform configuration.

BoundedPageSize.name: pageSize
BoundedPageSize.description: Page size for Agent choices and attempt history. Values outside the range are invalid.

ConfigPurpose.name: purpose
ConfigPurpose.description: Filter by intent; defaults to view. start applies to requirements. use applies to flows with requirementId. Use /api/catalog for Agents in a flow editor. Unsupported kind and purpose pairs return INVALID_REQUEST.

RequirementContext.name: requirementId
RequirementContext.description: Required for a flow use query. It binds the picker to a requirement the caller can start.

FlowContext.name: flowId
FlowContext.description: Existing flow being edited. Omit only when creating a flow.

PlatformOrigin.name: Origin
PlatformOrigin.description: Exact paired platform origin. Required by the local bridge.

username.description: Exact ASCII username. The platform normalizes letters to lowercase for identity matching.

phone.description: Include the country code. The server normalizes the number before uniqueness checking.

email.description: The normalized email uniqueness key ignores case.

registrationRef.description: Opaque proof scope for this registration. It confers no business access.

identifier.description: Email or exact username. ASCII username matching ignores letter case.

PublicationTarget.description: Reserved for the later formal publication profile. The first development release does not allow configuring or starting this target.

version.description: Optimistic configuration version used by expectedVersion. Graph and ownership edits both advance this value.

workflowVersion.description: Present on flows. Latest sealed graph version for RunStart.workflowVersion. Null on legacy metadata-only flows. Advances only on successful graph saves; ownership edits do not change it.

username.description: Exact ASCII username. The platform normalizes letters to lowercase for identity matching.

OwnershipReceipt.description: Opaque receipt. It carries no configuration, owner, candidate account or member data.

proofPublicKey.description: Ed25519 public key, SPKI DER encoded as unpadded Base64URL.

token.description: Returned only on successful pairing. Store locally and exclude from logs.

nonce.description: Single-use cryptographically random nonce, unpadded Base64URL.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical SD-I02 challenge message, unpadded Base64URL.

githubNamespace.description: Required only when the requirement has no linked repository. GitHub account or organization name.

GitPlan.description: A pending plan only, not evidence that a repository or branch exists. Actual default branch is discovered by Git preparation; never guessed as main or master.

ensureDev.description: Check dev exists and create it from the verified repository default branch if missing.

SelectedRole.description: Role pinned by the selected workflow version. Does not imply a task has been dispatched.

sequence.description: Serial child order; null for coordinator or parallel children.

roleDisplayName.description: Immutable Agent version display name. Never resolved against the current catalog.

disposition.description: Present when an authorized operator has skipped this failed role. Render the current role as skipped and retain failed as the attempt state. Omitted otherwise.

roleDisplayName.description: Display name from the selected immutable Agent version.

disposition.description: Present when the operator skipped this failed Agent attempt. It records the disposition separately from the failed attempt state. Omitted when no disposition was recorded.

operatorActions.description: Accepted retry and skip actions recorded against this exact attempt in acceptance order.

inputRequirementRevision.description: Null until the node wave starts; immutable for that wave thereafter.

basedOnOlderRequirementRevision.description: True when the pinned input revision is below the current run revision. False for an unstarted node.

artifacts.description: Final node outputs from its coordinator. Local Git refs identify an immutable device-local result.

sourceRequirementVersion.description: Source configuration version recorded with the current run revision. Compare with the live source version at write time.

csrfToken.description: Reserved for legacy release transports. The current browser sends X-CSRF-Token on release.

username.description: Exact ASCII username. The platform normalizes letters to lowercase for identity matching.

senderLabel.description: Agent display label from the frozen version when the sender is an Agent.

deliveryState.description: Present for a message delivered through the local Agent inbox.

ChatNodeTarget.description: Current node and wave with its selected roles. Null coordinator indicates the default target is unavailable.

targetId.description: Question, task, check node or proposal identifier, according to action. For message use targetRoleId.

targetRoleId.description: Optional for message. Omit to select the coordinator; explicit selection is scoped to the supplied node and wave.

nodeId.description: Current flow node for message or active BRD requirement action.

acceptsAgentJobs.description: Opt-in to role jobs for the bound device. Omitted and false keep Git-only behavior.

githubNamespace.description: Snapshotted account or organization for an unlinked requirement. Present only for public repository creation.

requirementRevision.description: Revision pinned by the node wave. A confirmed change does not rewrite messages for a started wave.

chatMessageId.description: Platform chat message corresponding to an ordinary user delivery.

outcome.description: Unresolved maps to needs_attention, and is never a selectable workflow route.

testedArtifactVersion.description: Exact immutable candidate reference checked by this wave, distinct from the report artifact.

candidateRef.description: Exact immutable candidate tested by this report, such as a build digest or a canonical code revision reference.

sequence.description: Contiguous event sequence starting at 1 for each task attempt and lease epoch.
Contiguous event sequence starting at 1 for each task attempt and lease epoch.
Contiguous event sequence starting at 1 for each task attempt and lease epoch.
Contiguous event sequence starting at 1 for each task attempt and lease epoch.
Contiguous event sequence starting at 1 for each task attempt and lease epoch.

inReplyToInboxId.description: Optional correlation to an inbox message already associated with this task and session.

decision.description: Only dispatch authorizes a new mutation until expiresAt. Other decisions permit reading and reconciling the existing provider result only.

retryable.description: The owner may approve again after a known failure before an external write was authorized.

retryApprovalAt.description: Original approval time identifying the eligible failed record.
Supply the exact value from the failed record to request a fresh approval. Omit for the first approval.

Error400.description: Invalid input, proof, graph, or missing description.

Error403.description: Current actor is forbidden for this action.

Error404.description: Object absent or invisible to this caller.

Error409.description: Conflict with current version, ownership, lease, or idempotency receipt.

Error410.description: Incremental cursor expired. Fetch a fresh authorized snapshot.

Error500.description: Unexpected failure. The request ID supports investigation.

Error503.description: Temporarily unavailable. Reuse the same idempotency key on a retry.
